assumptions.choice: Compute size = int(cash / (close * (1 + commission))) each entry using current available cash and the confirmed close as reference price.
assumptions.reason: Spec states '100% of available capital per trade'; integer share count derived from the close is the closest literal all-in size, with the (1+commission) factor reserving the 0.001 fee so the next-bar-open fill is not margin-rejected.

assumptions.choice: Signals are evaluated in next() on the closed bar; the resulting order fills at the next bar's open (backtrader default).
assumptions.reason: Spec says all signals are confirmed at the bar close but is silent on fill mechanics; the harness's default next-open execution is used.

assumptions.choice: When a position is open only exit rules are checked; no immediate reversal on the same bar an exit fires. A new (long or short) entry is possible only once flat.
assumptions.reason: Canonical default: hold at most one position, no re-entry/pyramiding while a position is open; the spec does not specify same-bar reversal.
